Energy flow and trophic structure of 
Galápagos shallow rocky reef systems 
along a gradient of productivity and 
artisanal fisheries 
 
by Diego J Ruiz Jarrin 
 
 
 
Doctoral thesis submitted in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the degree of 
Doctor of Natural Sciences (Dr. rer. nat.) to Faculty 2 (Biology and Chemistry), 
University of Bremen 
 
 
 
 
Bremen, June 30th, 2015 
 
 

 
The present study was conducted at the Charles Darwin Foundation (CDF) in Puerto 
Ayora, Galápagos, Ecuador and compiled at the Leibniz Center for Tropical Marine 
Ecology (ZMT) GmbH. 
The resulting publications are also a contribution of the CDF to achieve one of the 
goals of marine research by the “ Studies of the Galápagos Marine Trophic Network ” 
included in the CDF’s Annual Operating Plan since 2011. 
 
 
 
 
First Examiner Prof. Dr. Matthias Wolff 
  Leibniz Center for Tropical Marine Ecology, 
  Bremen, Germany 
   University of Bremen
